name: multi-axis: a Ø40 × 60 shaft along X; 4-axis rotary finishing — the moves carry A, the program writes A words
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'circle', c: [0, 0], r: 20 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'right' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 60 })); }); await sleep(1500); await m.run('camRotary4'); await sleep(600); const cam = m.mfg.cam.camOf(); const op = cam.ops.at(-1); const note = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="camOpPattern"]')); await m.mfg.cam.generate(); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.mfg.cam.program(); i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(300); const prog = m.mfg.cam.program(); const g = await m.mfg.cam.gcode(); const tp = prog?.paths?.find((p) => p.op === op.id); const feeds = tp?.moves.filter((mv) => mv.k === 'f') ?? []; return JSON.stringify({ type: op.type, tool: cam.tools.find((x) => x.id === op.tool)?.type, note, multi: tp?.multi, onRadius: feeds.length > 100 && feeds.every((mv) => Math.abs(mv.mp[2] - 20) < 0.05), aWords: (String(g).match(/ A\d/g) ?? []).length > 100 }); })()

name: multi-axis: the 4-axis program simulated — the stock cut all round the A axis, no gouges, shown whole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('camSimulate'); for (let i = 0; i < 600 && !m.mfg.cam.simulation(); i++) await sleep(200); await sleep(500); const s = m.mfg.cam.simulation(); const body = m.viewport.bodies.get('cam:stock'); return JSON.stringify({ ran: Boolean(s), skipped: s?.skipped, full: s?.full, removed: (s?.removed ?? 0) > 1000, gouges: s?.gouges, shown: (body?.mesh?.geometry?.index?.count ?? 0) > 3000 }); })()

name: multi-axis: 5-axis finishing on the same shaft — tilted tool axes, G43.4 with A / C, the stock simulation runs
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const cam0 = m.mfg.cam.camOf(); m.actions.change('op.cam', () => { cam0.ops = []; }); await m.run('camMulti5'); await sleep(600); const cam = m.mfg.cam.camOf(); const op = cam.ops.at(-1); await m.mfg.cam.generate(); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.mfg.cam.program(); i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(300); const prog = m.mfg.cam.program(); const g = await m.mfg.cam.gcode(); const tp = prog?.paths?.find((p) => p.op === op.id); const tilt = Math.max(...(tp?.moves ?? []).filter((mv) => mv.k === 'f').map((mv) => Math.acos(mv.t[2]) * 180 / Math.PI)); await m.mfg.cam.simulate(); await sleep(300); const sim = m.mfg.cam.simulation(); return JSON.stringify({ type: op.type, multi: tp?.multi, tilted: tilt > 20 && tilt <= 60 + 1e-6, tcp: /G43\.4/.test(g) && /G49/.test(g), ac: / A[\d.-]+ C[\d.-]+/.test(g), sim: Boolean(sim && sim.removed > 0), rapid: sim?.rapidCuts }); })()

name: multi-axis: a Ø60 flange with four Ø6 holes on a 44 mm circle; mill-turn face drilling by C angle on the lathe (G83, C words)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'circle', c: [0, 0], r: 30 }, { kind: 'circle', c: [22, 0], r: 3 }, { kind: 'circle', c: [0, 22], r: 3 }, { kind: 'circle', c: [-22, 0], r: 3 }, { kind: 'circle', c: [0, -22], r: 3 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 12 })); }); await sleep(1500); await m.run('camMillTurnAxial'); await sleep(800); const cam = m.mfg.cam.camOf(); const op = cam.ops.at(-1); const list = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-select="camNewOpType"] option')].map((o) => o.value); await m.mfg.cam.generate(); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.mfg.cam.program(); i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(300); const prog = m.mfg.cam.program(); const g = await m.mfg.cam.gcode(); const tp = prog?.paths?.find((p) => p.op === op.id); return JSON.stringify({ machine: cam.machine, type: op.type, offered: list.includes('mtRadial') && list.includes('tRough'), holes: tp?.holes, g83: (String(g).match(/G83 /g) ?? []).length, c: /G0 C/.test(g), live: /M13/.test(g) }); })()

name: multi-axis: the mill-turn program simulated — the live-tool holes drilled into a 3D model of the bar, shown whole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('camSimulate'); for (let i = 0; i < 600 && !m.mfg.cam.simulation(); i++) await sleep(200); await sleep(500); const s = m.mfg.cam.simulation(); const body = m.viewport.bodies.get('cam:stock'); return JSON.stringify({ ran: Boolean(s), skipped: s?.skipped, live: (s?.live?.removed ?? 0) > 100, shown: (body?.mesh?.geometry?.index?.count ?? 0) > 3000 }); })()
